author: lilianweng
text:
Contrastive learning aims to learn representation such that similar samples stay close, while dissimilar ones are far apart. It can be applied to supervised / unsupervised data and has been shown to achieve good results on various tasks.

📚 A long read: https://t.co/TZiaVA0qNS

author: lilianweng
text: I've read so many papers with small incremental changes that can be well summarized in one sentence. I wish there is a better way to share incremental improvements & corresponding experimental results. They are interesting and valuable but a full 10-page paper seems too long.
